n01.roman: FICCI-EY ki 2026 wali report kehti hai: 2025 mein Bharat mein kareeb 52 crore gamers the!

n02.roman: Matlab har teen Bharatiyon mein se ek se zyada! Aur 10 crore se zyada log roz khelte hain.

n03.roman: Par twist: usi saal online gaming ki kamaai 17% gir gayi!

n04.roman: Wajah? Paise wale games par ban. Unki kamaai 26% ghati.

n05.roman: Lekin video games mein, in-app khareedari 15% badhi!

n06.roman: Video games aur esports ki kamaai milakar, 2025 mein 6,300 crore rupaye thi. Aur 2028 tak 9,200 crore ka anumaan!

n07.roman: Yaani paise wale games gire, aur video games badh rahe hain!
